on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  workflow_call:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  fast:
    name: Fast tests and lint (Python ${{ matrix.python-version }})
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        python-version: ["3.10", "3.11", "3.12", "3.13", "3.14"]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v5
        with:
          version: latest
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
      - name: Install development and all-backend dependencies
        run: uv sync --python ${{ matrix.python-version }} --extra dev --extra all
      - name: Run offline tests
        run: uv run --python ${{ matrix.python-version }} pytest -m 'not slow' tests/
      - name: Lint and type-check
        run: uv run --python ${{ matrix.python-version }} make lint

  browsers:
    name: All-backend browser tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v5
        with:
          version: latest
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
      - name: Install development and all-backend dependencies
        run: uv sync --python 3.12 --extra dev --extra all
      - name: Install Chromium
        run: uv run playwright install chromium --with-deps
      - name: Run browser tests against local fixtures
        run: uv run pytest -vv tests/browsers/

  wheel:
    name: Build wheel for isolated extras checks
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v5
        with:
          version: latest
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
      - name: Build wheel
        run: uv build --wheel
      - name: Upload wheel
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: built-wheel
          path: dist/*.whl
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 1

  installed-extras:
    name: Installed wheel (${{ matrix.extra }})
    needs: wheel
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        extra: [base, httpx, playwright, all]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v5
        with:
          version: latest
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
      - name: Download built wheel
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: built-wheel
          path: dist
      - name: Check wheel in isolated environment
        run: python scripts/check_wheel.py dist/*.whl --extra ${{ matrix.extra }}

.PHONY: test
test:
	uv run pytest --cov=extract_emails -vv -m "not slow" tests/

.PHONY: test-all
test-all:
	uv run pytest --cov=extract_emails -vv tests/

.PHONY: test-browsers
test-browsers:
	uv run pytest -vv tests/browsers/

.PHONY: format
format:
	uv run ruff check extract_emails tests scripts --select I --fix
	uv run ruff format extract_emails tests scripts

.PHONY: lint
lint:
	uv run ruff check extract_emails tests scripts
	uv run mypy extract_emails scripts

.PHONY: docs-serve
docs-serve:
	uv run mkdocs serve

.PHONY: docs-publish
docs-publish:
	uv run mkdocs gh-deploy --force

.PHONY: publish
publish:
	uv build
	uv publish

name = "extract-emails"

]

keywords = ["parser", "email", "linkedin"]
classifiers = [

  "Operating System :: Unix",
  "Programming Language :: Python :: 3.10",

  "Programming Language :: Python :: 3.13",
  "Programming Language :: Python :: 3.14",
  "Programming Language :: Python :: Implementation :: CPython",
  "Topic :: Utilities",
]
dependencies = [
    "aiocsv>=1.4.1",
    "aiofiles>=25.1.0",
    "click>=8.1",
    "loguru>=0.7.3",
    "lxml>=6.1.3",
    "pydantic>=2.14.1",
]

[project.urls]
repository = "https://github.com/dmitriiweb/extract-emails"
documentation = "https://dmitriiweb.github.io/extract-emails"

[project.optional-dependencies]
all = [
    "httpx>=0.28.1",
    "playwright>=1.64.0",
] 
httpx = [
    "httpx>=0.28.1",
]
playwright = [

]
dev = [
    "jinja2>=3.1.6",
    "lxml-stubs>=0.5.1",

    "pytest-cov>=7.1.0",
    "ruff>=0.17.1",
    "tox>=4.65.0",
    "types-aiofiles>=25.1.0.20260518",
]

[build-system]
requires = ["hatchling"]
build-backend = "hatchling.build"

[project.scripts]
extract-emails = "extract_emails.console.application:main"

[tool.pytest.ini_options]
